title: 航空宇宙文献調査入門
subtitle: Introduction to Aerospace Literature Survey
keywords: Report preparation 2.Document retrieval 3.Information collection 4.Utilization of database 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn how to prepare an engineering report. (2) learn how to search engineering documents. (3) consider the future major subject they will study in PD III. (4) learn to express their ideas through engineering reports.
advice: This is a basic engineering report preparation skills course. We will cover the following: 1. Problem discovery 2. Intelligence, analysis and rearranging 3. Problem solving 4. Engineering report preparation 5. Distinguishing plagiarism and quotation Students are required to understand technological trends in the aerospace field. Students are requested to discover problems in the field of the aeronautical engineering and examine them intellectually through analysis and rearranging. Students are expected to learn the method of expression and the correct report format for the field of aeronautical engineering and how to prepare a paper.
requiredKnowledge: Advanced reading and writing abilities on personal events. Be familiar with the usage of the Internet and the Library Center.

activityGoals.body: Be able to discover problems in the field of aerospace engineering and set the theme of a report.
Be able to collect, analyze, and arrange information in the field of aerospace engineering.
Be able to create a report which meets the requirements of the field of aerospace engineering.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい。     授業明細   回数
